prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE polished journal-paper figure on pure white, wide 2:1 composition. Elegant open-layout scientific vector illustration with expertly balanced whitespace, dark navy labels, teal and indigo accents, precise thin arrows, consistent refined line icons. ABSOLUTELY NO surrounding rectangles, no rounded boxes, no cards, no panels, no frames, no background bands, no outer container, no giant title, no footer, no legend, no decorative gradients. Draw relationships using free-standing icons, text, small dots and lines. Only the requested labels, readable at 900px display width. One message per figure. It is a software framework, not a laboratory scene. Message: research intent is translated into an orchestration plan that coordinates specialist agents, with results informing the plan. Left: a small intent/compass line icon above the label 'Research intent'. Center, visually dominant: a tasteful open node-link branching-and-joining graph, just 6 small circular nodes connected by directional lines, no node boxes or task labels. Caption beneath this graph: 'Orchestration Plan'; smaller word above: 'Orchestrator'. A single arrow from research intent reaches the graph. Right: four free-standing line icons arranged in a loose 2x2 constellation beneath the group label 'Specialist agents'; short labels 'Design', 'Manipulation', 'Equipment', 'Analysis'. One thin arrow from the plan toward this constellation labelled 'Tasks'; a separate teal curved feedback arrow from the constellation back to the plan labelled 'Results'. Do not connect the agents in a sequence or a ring. Their roles are examples, not a closed inventory. No physical equipment drawings, internal control layers, safety, knowledge, tools or deployment details in this figure.
